transcript.text: In the world of an infinite scroll, how
do you suggest somebody build structure?
I would put as much friction as possible
between you and the things that distract
you and as much lubrication between you
and the things that you want to do. So,
for example, I have an app that like I
have to scan and I can put the token in
another room and like my phone cannot
unlock until I physically go do that.
So, that's number one. Number two is I
have physical things that slow down like
even if that's not on, if I go on any
social media, I have to wait 10 seconds
between me hitting the app and it
starting. So, it delays [music] the
reward cycle. The third thing is that if
I'm going to post, I'll typically post
through a tool
even if I want to post in real time so
that I don't go on the platform to try
and make a post and then lose 15 minutes
getting, you know, sucked in. And so,
those are just like three micro examples
of ways that I can just distance myself
from something that distracts me. And
then obviously on the other hand, uh
lubricating the path of getting things
done is just removing all distractions
besides the work that you want to do.
